richiami.difetto: Under certain circumstances the fuel filter outlet pipe union may contact the heating element fitted to the fuel filter body. This will result in a short circuit with possible fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the subject vehicles for the inclusion of a fuse link in the fuel filter heating element circuit and the fitment of a clip to ensure that the filter outlet pipe union is held clear of the element body.

richiami.difetto: The left hand fog light wiring loom may chafe in the area of the towing eye. This could cause a short circuit with possible risk of fire.

richiami.titolo: CHAFING OF FOG LAMP WIRING LOOM

richiami.difetto: Due to the effect of corrosion on the aluminium spacer at the master cylinder mounting it is possible for the brake master cylinder to detach from the airpac unit rendering one half of the service brake system inoperative.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a re-designed spacer to the brake master cylinder mounting.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER ATTACHMENT

richiami.difetto: 1) Bonnet catch securing bolts may slacken in service allowing movement of the lock mechanism. This may result in the bonnet lifting. 2) Autoliv-Klippan seat belt pre-tensioners may be faulty.
richiami.rimedio: 1. Replace the bonnet catch fixing bolts with screws and lock nuts. 2. Substitute any Autoliv-Klippan pre-tensioners with TRW-REPA equipment.
richiami.titolo: 1) BONNET CATCH MECHANISM MAY LOOSEN. 2) SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONERS MAY BE FAULTY.

richiami.difetto: Incorrect positioning and/or tightening of the fuel pipe clips on the injection bar may cause petrol fumes or smell in the passenger compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection. Where the subject pipes have been incorrectly positioned and/or tightened the pipes will be replaced.

richiami.difetto: The front suspension upper mounting plate cups may crack. Under certain conditions this could affect vehicle handling.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the front suspension upper mounting plates with examples incorporating an alternative metal specification.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF FRONT SUSPENSION UPPER MOUNTING

richiami.difetto: Possible fracture of the stub axle(s) on high mileage passenger carrying vehicles. This could result in loss of the wheel and hub assembly with attendant loss of vehicle control and braking effort on one brake circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the stub axle during normal routine servicing or repair with new units incorporating a revised heat treatment requirement.
